target.statement: Ours-BERT achieves 86.16 accuracy on the BQ dataset (short text matching), outperforming the BERT baseline (84.8).

compute.basis: The method requires crawling search-engine contexts for every short text, training a BERT-based context selector and a context-enhanced BERT matcher on the full BQ dataset; no code or crawled contexts are released, and the paper reports all experiments on V100 GPUs.

blockers: No released crawled context data; contexts must be re-crawled from a search engine, which is non-deterministic and may be blocked
Requires training/fine-tuning BERT-based models on a large Chinese dataset
Paper reports V100 GPU training; CPU-only reproduction would be impractically slow
title: Context Enhanced Short Text Matching using Clickthrough Data
